search.title: Search
search.browserNote: The portals are read from this browser through the buscapiso extension. Keep this tab open.

map.title: Map of your listings
map.help: Blue dots are your best matches. Black dots are your places.
listing.travelSource.graph: Times estimated from the metro network.
profile.pickHelp: Press "Place on map" on a place, then click the map to move it there.
profile.realTravelTimes: Listings to check with real timetables
travel.title: Travel times
travel.transitousHelp: Free real timetables, buses included, with nothing to set up. Change the server below to use your own MOTIS.
travel.transitousTerms: Transitous is a free community service for open-source, non-commercial projects. buscapiso asks it for one route per place you add.
travel.googleHelp: Real timetables from Google. You need your own API key: in console.cloud.google.com create a project, turn on billing, enable "Routes API", create an API key restricted to it, and paste it here. Google charges per route with a monthly free allowance.
travel.keySaved: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
travel.testRoute: From Plaça de Sants to your first place:
travel.serverHelp: Leave the public Transitous server, or point this at your own MOTIS (for example http://localhost:8080). See the README for how to run one.
ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.help: With your own key, the AI reads the best listings of each search: who lives there, bills, rules, short lets and warning signs. It also drafts messages. Without a key everything still works.
ai.claudeHelp: Create a key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys (pay as you go).
ai.geminiHelp: Create a key at aistudio.google.com → Get API key. It has a free tier.
ai.openaiHelp: Create a key at platform.openai.com → API keys.
ai.openrouterHelp: One key for many models: openrouter.ai → Keys.
ai.ollamaHelp: Free and private. Install Ollama, run "ollama pull" with a model, and write its name here. No key needed. Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS set to this site's address so the browser can reach it.
ai.modelHelp: The list could not be loaded. Write the model name exactly as your provider does.
ai.keySaved: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
ai.aboutMeHelp: Used in message drafts. For example: Ana, 27, nurse at Hospital Clínic, non-smoker, looking from November.

welcome.placesHelp: Work, university… Travel time to each one decides which areas are searched.

ai.keyLocal: Keys are stored in this browser only and sent only to that provider.
extension.add: To search the portals from this browser, add the buscapiso extension. It reads only the rental portals, and only when you search.
extension.addFirefox: To search the portals from Firefox, add the buscapiso extension. It reads only the rental portals, and only when you search.
extension.orImport: You can also use the list someone else made:
extension.noSearchHere: Searching needs a computer with Chrome, Edge or Firefox. Ask someone to send you an export, or make one yourself, and import it here: everything else works on this device.
extension.homeScreen: Tip: add buscapiso to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) so Safari keeps your data.
extension.outdated: Please update the buscapiso extension: this version of the site needs a newer one.
data.persisted: The browser has agreed to keep it.
data.notPersisted: The browser may delete it if space runs out, so make a backup now and then.
data.private: Your data stays in this browser. buscapiso has no server.
data.exportHelp: "Export to share" saves the listings only, to send to someone else; their device scores them with their own settings. "Back up everything" also saves your statuses, notes, profiles and settings. Keys are never exported.
data.tooBig: The file is larger than 50 MB.
data.previewLine: {count} listings · {city} · {types} · searched {from} to {to} · {fresh} new to you
data.previewBackup: Also {states} statuses and notes, and {profiles} profiles. Yours are never overwritten.
data.skipped: {count} listings in the file were not valid and will be skipped.
data.keepsYours: Your own statuses and notes stay as they are.
data.imported: Imported: {added} new listings, {updated} updated. They are scored with your settings.
data.clear: Delete all data in this browser
data.clearSure: This deletes every listing, status, note, profile, setting and key in this browser. It cannot be undone.
